Elevated within one of Paddington's most prestigious enclaves, 41 Wilden Street is not just a residence; it is a sublime expression of contemporary, mid-century inspired architecture. A collaboration between the owners and the renowned CG Design Studios, this award-winning sanctuary has reimagined an original worker's cottage into a sophisticated family retreat where the city skyline serves as a breathtaking, ever-changing backdrop.

Commanding an enviable position, the home's elevation is the hero of the design.  Floor to ceiling glass retracts to frame sweeping, unobstructed city views, transforming the twinkling skyline into a living piece of art.  

At the heart of the home are the open-plan kitchen, dining, and "sunken" lounge.   The sunken lounge is a chic conversation pit anchored by a suspended fireplace, which offers an immediate sense of warmth and drama.  Honed concrete floors provide a cool, tactile foundation underfoot, while the kitchen presents as a culinary temple featuring exquisite Artedomus marble and premium Neff appliances.  This social hub flows effortlessly toward the view, while a shimmering, fully tiled pool is tucked into a central courtyard, remaining visible from the kitchen to ensure a constant connection to the water.

Occupying the entire top level, the master suite is a true architectural sanctuary that feels like a high-end boutique hotel.  This private retreat offers a secluded balcony overlooking the city and a spa-like ensuite complete with a freestanding bath for the ultimate indulgence.  For children or guests, the lower level reveals a bright, casual living zone with a seamless connection to the flat lawn and gardens, complemented by a sauna and a bathroom cleverly concealed behind stunning timber panelling.  Even the practicalities are handled with innovative engineering; solving the inner-city parking puzzle, a double carport with a hydraulic lift lowers vehicles into a massive secure garage with ample space for additional cars, a boat, or lifestyle toys.

Beyond the front door, you are immersed in the pulse of Paddington, just a short stroll from the vibrant boutiques, bars, and cafes of Latrobe & Given Terrace.  For sports and entertainment enthusiasts, Suncorp Stadium is a casual walk away, making world-class events a seamless part of your lifestyle.  Positioned just 4km from the CBD and a short walk to express bus services, this is the ultimate in inner-city connectivity.

This location is equally unparalleled for its educational prestige, sitting within the coveted Milton State School catchment and offering easy access to St Joseph's Primary, All Hallows', Gregory Terrace, Stuartholme, Marist College Ashgrove, both Brisbane Grammar Schools and The Gap & Kelvin Grove high schools.

This is a home that doesn't just look beautiful - it performs.  Honoured by the HIA for both Residential Design and Sustainable Living, the property features integrated sound, solar power, security, and ducted air-conditioning throughout.  Rarely does a home of such architectural pedigree and location become available.  This is your opportunity to secure an envied Paddington lifestyle where the city is your backyard, and every elite amenity is at your door.

- Outstanding Elevation and Stunning City Views
- HIA Awarded & Designed by CG Design Studios
- Fully Tiled, Sparkling Swimming Pool
- Sauna
